room_rent.display: At actuals up to SI (base); 2% of SI/day optional modifier
room_rent.note: Base plan covers room rent at actuals up to Sum Insured. An optional base cover modifier caps room rent at 2% of SI per day.

icu.display: At actuals up to SI (base); 4% of SI/day optional modifier
icu.note: Base plan covers ICU at actuals up to Sum Insured. Optional modifier caps ICU at 4% of SI per day.

copayment.note: Co-payment is an optional add-on (D.15); once opted it cannot be removed at renewal. OPD cover (D.9) has its own 50% co-pay on professional fees and 30% on diagnostics/pharmacy.

sub_limits.display: Bariatric up to ₹50K; AYUSH up to SI; ambulance ₹3,000/hosp; health check-up ₹5,000
sub_limits.note: Bariatric surgery sub-limited to ₹50,000 (optional modifier). Emergency road ambulance ₹3,000 per hospitalisation. Stay Fit health check-up ₹5,000. Main inpatient, day care, modern treatments covered up to full SI.

initial_waiting.note: Waived for accidents; also waived after 24 months continuous coverage.

ped_waiting.note: Reducible via portability credit from prior continuous coverage.

specific_disease_waiting.note: Covers listed conditions e.g. cataract, hernia, joint replacement, gallbladder, etc.

maternity.note: Section D.12.1 Women Care Benefit; 48-month waiting period; max 2 deliveries lifetime; pre-natal and post-natal (8 weeks) included.

cumulative_bonus.display: Up to 200% of base SI (50%/yr, optional)
cumulative_bonus.note: Booster Benefit is an optional add-on (D.10); 50% of base SI added per claim-free year, max 200% of base SI; reduces at same rate if claim made.

restoration.note: Section D.5 Unlimited Refill is an optional add-on; triggered from first claim; covers both related and unrelated illnesses; each refill up to 100% of base SI.

day_care.note: Minimum 2 hours admission; includes angiography, dialysis, radiotherapy, chemotherapy.

domiciliary.note: Domiciliary hospitalisation is explicitly excluded under Specific Exclusion VIII.

ayush.note: Section C.8; inpatient AYUSH in recognised AYUSH hospitals; sub-limit as per policy schedule (shown as 'up to SI' in benefit table).

organ_donor.note: Policy wording does not explicitly mention organ donor expense cover.

ambulance.note: Section C.5; covers transfer to nearest hospital, hospital-to-hospital, and hospital-to-home.

modern_treatments.note: Section C.7 lists 12 modern/advanced procedures including robotic surgery, oral chemo, stem cell therapy etc.; covered as inpatient or day care up to Sum Insured.

consumables.note: Non-payable consumables (List I items) are excluded by default; optional Claims Safeguard benefit D.8 waives this exclusion.

global_cover.note: Section D.13 Global Treatment covers listed serious illnesses/procedures treated outside India; 36-month waiting period; reimbursement only; Unlimited Refill not applicable.

moratorium.note: After 60 continuous months no claim can be contested except on grounds of fraud.

grace_period.note: 30 days for annual/half-yearly/quarterly; 15 days for monthly instalment. Coverage not available during grace period except where instalment premium is paid.

free_look.note: Applicable to new individual policies with tenure of 1 year or more.

portability.note: Apply at least 30 days before renewal; credits for PED, waiting periods, moratorium transferred.

notable_exclusions.display: Domiciliary hospitalisation, external congenital anomaly, vaccination, home visit fees, treatment outside India (base), circumcision, OPD (base)

optional_riders.display: Unlimited Refill, Booster Benefit, Maternity+Newborn, Critical Illness (60 CIs), Global Treatment, OPD Cover, Hospital Daily Cash, Claims Safeguard, Accidental Death, Vector Borne, Wellness
